s.how: Wrap 16 cocktail franks in half rashers of bacon, 8 rashers in total, and griddle until crisp. Tuck into 16 mini rolls with warm pinto beans, diced tomato and onion, mustard and jalapeño salsa.
Layer a 300g bag of corn chips with a drained tin of black beans, 200g cheddar and jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt and spoon on with 150g sour cream.

m.note: the lawn mowing money he hands over to Cindy
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g beef mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp mustard. Stack two per toasted bun with pickles, onion and the sauce. Fry 1kg crinkle-cut potatoes twice.

w.note: their first public date in town
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate into 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and pipe whipped cream high. Top with chopped peanuts and a cherry.

d.note: the borrowed white suede outfit and the red wine stain
d.how: Pour 500ml cranberry juice and 750ml lemonade into a big jug with ice and sliced orange. Stir gently and pour carefully into glasses, nowhere near anyone's borrowed white suede outfit.
